# MiniMax M3.1 Flash TP2 production receipts for the defaults-on equivalence test (tests/minimax_defaults_tests.cpp).
# The plain invocation (no option, no env) must resolve to exactly the configuration these processes ran with.
#
# rank: measured production invocation, re-run with the adopted defaults, the uncached prefill
#   exchange enabled (STRIX_MM_PF_TX_UNCACHED=1) and the DSpark Markov cand form (STRIX_MM_MARKOV=cand, C 4096,
#   |H| 8192, top-C v2). Env lines = every value those processes ran with: set by the app
#   (hp transport, deferred CRC), code defaults (decode/prefill items), the adopted items.
# serve: measured production command (both ranks), same engine values.
receipt rank
argv $M 0 usb4-auto $OUT --slots 8 --capacity 8256 --max-rows 4096 --gate oracle-A --gate-layers 6 --decode-check prompts/p1k.u32:24 --decode-check prompts/chat-prose.u32:16 --session 1k:prompts/p1k.u32:64 --session 8k:prompts/p8k.u32:16 --batch prompts/p1k.u32:24:1,2,4,8 --session jtb:chat/json-table.u32:256 --session cpy:chat/code-py.u32:256 --session pen:chat/prose-en.u32:256 --dspark-exl3 minimax-drafts/dspark-exl3-K4fc --spec jtb:chat/json-table.u32:256:auto --spec cpy:chat/code-py.u32:256:auto --spec pen:chat/prose-en.u32:256:auto
plain $M 0 usb4-auto $OUT
env STRIX_MMX_MOE_WIDE=2
env STRIX_MM_INDEX_CONC=1
env STRIX_MMX_CRC=deferred
env STRIX_MM_XB_WAIT=1
env STRIX_MM_XB_INPLACE=1
env STRIX_MM_XB_PUBLISH=1
env STRIX_MM_XB_POSTILP=2
env STRIX_MM_XB_WARM=8
env STRIX_MM_DSPARK_ATTN=2
env STRIX_MM_DRAFT_LIN=opt
env STRIX_MMX_LINEAR_V11=1
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV=cand
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV_C=4096
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV_H=8192
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV_TOPC=v2
env STRIX_MMX_PREFILL_CORE=v4
env STRIX_MM_PF_MSA_BATCH=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_ATTEND4=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_ROUTER_BATCH=1
env STRIX_MMX_PREFILL_MTFIT=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_MSA_REWORK=3
env STRIX_MM_PF_IDX_TILE=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_IDX_ROWS=64
env STRIX_MMX_PREFILL_PIPE=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_KV_TILE=auto
env STRIX_MM_PF_TX_UNCACHED=1
env STRIX_DIST_CRC_PARALLEL=1
env STRIX_DIST_HOST_CRC_OVERLAP=1
env STRIX_DIST_HOST_CHUNK_BYTES=1048576
end
receipt serve
argv $M --rank 0 --transport usb4-auto --slots 8 --port 18321 --resume-check prompts/p1k.u32:1/7/60,p4608.u32:7
plain $M --rank 0
env STRIX_MMX_MOE_WIDE=2
env STRIX_MM_INDEX_CONC=1
env STRIX_MMX_CRC=deferred
env STRIX_MM_XB_WAIT=1
env STRIX_MM_XB_INPLACE=1
env STRIX_MM_XB_PUBLISH=1
env STRIX_MM_XB_POSTILP=2
env STRIX_MM_XB_WARM=8
env STRIX_MM_DSPARK_ATTN=2
env STRIX_MM_DRAFT_LIN=opt
env STRIX_MMX_LINEAR_V11=1
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV=cand
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV_C=4096
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV_H=8192
env STRIX_MM_MARKOV_TOPC=v2
env STRIX_MMX_PREFILL_CORE=v4
env STRIX_MM_PF_MSA_BATCH=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_ATTEND4=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_ROUTER_BATCH=1
env STRIX_MMX_PREFILL_MTFIT=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_MSA_REWORK=3
env STRIX_MM_PF_IDX_TILE=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_IDX_ROWS=64
env STRIX_MMX_PREFILL_PIPE=1
env STRIX_MM_PF_KV_TILE=auto
env STRIX_MM_PF_TX_UNCACHED=1
env STRIX_DIST_CRC_PARALLEL=1
env STRIX_DIST_HOST_CRC_OVERLAP=1
env STRIX_DIST_HOST_CHUNK_BYTES=1048576
end
